div.p: Bellbird Corner is a notable eastern suburban colony of bell miners in Blackburn. In the 1980s, a National Trust classification and local planning scheme protected the landscape significance of the area as a special residential zone, ensuring protection of the tree canopy as a habitat for the birds.
